smsCol.title: SMS: real limitations.
smsCol.subtitle: SMS works, but has structural limits that WhatsApp solves natively.
smsCol.smsReason1: Low open rates compared to WhatsApp — business SMS messages are often ignored or filtered as spam.
smsCol.smsReason2: Text only. No images, PDFs, audio, video, interactive buttons, or structured templates.
smsCol.smsReason3: Zero read receipts. No way to know if the client actually read the message.
smsCol.smsReason4: Fixed and rising per-message costs. WhatsApp Business API uses a conversation-based pricing model, not per individual message.
smsCol.verdict: WhatsApp is Meta's official channel for business communication — with dedicated infrastructure, templates, and API.

clientCol.title: Your clients are already asking for it.
clientCol.subtitle: You don't need to convince them — they're the ones asking. The question is: is your software ready to answer?
clientCol.clientReason1: "Can I reach you on WhatsApp?" — the question your end clients ask businesses every day.
clientCol.clientReason2: WhatsApp is the dominant messaging app in Italy and Europe. It's where people already communicate.
clientCol.clientReason3: WhatsApp communication is perceived as more direct and personal than email or SMS.
clientCol.clientReason4: Software houses that integrate WhatsApp differentiate their product on something clients see and use every day.

pricing.subtitle: First connection at €0. From the second onward you pay in brackets — the more clients you have, the less you pay per connection.
pricing.noSubscriptionNote: No subscription, no fixed costs. Add and remove connections at any time.
pricing.graduatedNote: Graduated pricing: each connection is billed at its tier rate. Adding your 10th connection does not retroactively raise the price of the first 9.

STARTER.name: Starter
STARTER.description: From the 2nd to the 9th connection. Pay only for active ones.

GROWTH.name: Growth
GROWTH.description: From the 10th to the 24th connection. Lower price as you grow.

SCALE.name: Scale
SCALE.description: From the 25th connection onward. Best price for high volumes.
